 Raiffeisen Bank
 Java Developer – Smart Banking Manager
 As a Java Developer at Raiffeisen Bank, you will have the opportunity to work on an exciting project called SBM (Smart Banking Manager). SBM is a crucial application that orchestrates orders (Product Ordering) related to the main business processes of the bank (e.g. card opening and maintenance, current account opening and maintenance, product bundles), keeps the customers' assets for further use in external applications and also aims to be the main source of the bank's product catalogue.
You will play an important role in the development and maintenance of the Smart Banking Manager application and will have a direct impact on the bank’s business processes.
 What do we do? 💻
Develop software products based on requirements of course, but not only:
Understand and, if needed, challenge the requirements from business
Actively participate in agile ceremonies, software detail design, software development, quality assurance, user acceptance and launching into production phases.
Build Java-based applications that cover all the basic architectural principles starting from high-volume & low-latency systems to critical systems in a high-availability environments
Contribute with the rest of the team to continuous improvements of the development process
Level 3 support for live applications
